After securing your secrets in storage platforms, make use of secret management features that come with your CI/CD tools.
Many CI/CD tools come with built-in secret management capabilities:
: Offers encrypted secrets at both the repository and organization levels. Secrets are automatically masked in logs and only accessible to authorized workflows.
: Provides protected variables and group-level secrets, allowing secure sharing across projects while maintaining isolation.
: Works with credentials plugins and supports external secret stores. Plugins are required to ensure secrets are masked in logs.

Key points for secure secret management:
: Rely on platforms that provide encryption both during storage and transit.
: Implement scanning tools to identify secret exposures early.
: Keep detailed audit logs of secret access and modifications.
: Set up clear processes for addressing exposed secrets and rolling back changes when necessary.
Effective secret management shifts security from being an obstacle to becoming a support system for continuous delivery.
